text:
Taylor: Heads-up: first-run setup checklist feels modal-heavy and interrupts flow. A few folks in testing thought the checklist was mandatory even though steps are optional. Screenshot and short vid coming. Rhea: Interesting. Is the CTA copy maybe driving that? We currently show "Complete setup" which implies required. Suggest "Try later" on skip and change CTA to "Finish optional steps"? Not perfect, open to better wording. Marco: UX note: the progress steps use a pure CSS counter with aria-hidden spans; AT users get no progress announcement. We should add `aria-valuenow` / role=progressbar or an accessible live region update on step change. Ben: Also saw a focus trap issue: when you mark a step complete the focus moves to an off-screen toast (which is removed instantly) and keyboard users lose context. Need to keep focus on the step header or to the next actionable control. Rhea: Agree on wording. Proposal: primary CTA "Complete optional steps", secondary "Skip for now". Add helper copy: "You can finish these later from Settings > Getting started". Short and scannable. Taylor: Love that. Also consider a persistent mini-checklist in the right rail (collapsible) so users don't feel forced into a modal. On mobile that would be a bottom sheet. Marco: Accessibility plan: replace the visual-only counters with a `role=progressbar` with `aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="33"` and update aria-live region when a step completes:```html
Step 2 of 6: Connect a model added
``` This should make it clearer to SR users. Ben: For the focus trap we can follow pattern: after completing a step, programmatically move focus to the next step's primary button, not a toast. If no next step, move to the checklist toggle. Avoid focusing removed nodes. QA-bot: Reminder: add `onboarding.checklist.complete` and `onboarding.checklist.skip` events to telemetry. Tag @growth for funnel. Taylor: Small visual nit: the check icons are red on hover due to shared CSS variable; makes completed tasks look like errors when people hover. Change hover state to a muted green or subtle gray. Rhea: I'll update the copy and create two label variants for testing: A) "Complete optional steps" + helper copy, B) "Get started with sample projects" + small inline explanation. We'll A/B in the next experiment. Marco: Dev note: for the rail mini-checklist on mobile, keep DOM order: rail toggle -> list. If we move elements visually make sure `aria-hidden` applied accordingly or rebuild in DOM order to preserve linear reading. Avoid JS-only reorders where possible. Ben: I'll prototype the focus behavior and fix the toast timing in `eng/onboarding/focus-fix`. Will also create a short keyboard walkthrough script for QA. Taylor: Can we test with 6 users on Thursday? Prefer a mix of power users and fresh signups. Rhea + Ben can run the sessions. Rhea: Yep, scheduled 11am PT. We'll capture screens and SR audio for anomalies. Taylor: Thanks team. After the test we'll decide whether to keep modal-first or shift to rail-first onboarding. Ping me when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
